request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir, piano, cello, strings, soft drums, 80 BPM, majestic, tender
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We groan inwardly in our weakness
Waiting for redemption of our bodies
We do not know what to pray for
As we ought in this dark place

[Pre-Chorus]
But the Spirit helps us in our frailty
He intercedes for the saints

[Chorus]
With groanings too deep for words
He prays to the Father above
The Spirit intercedes for us
According to God’s holy will

[Verse]
He who searches our hearts knows
The mind of the Spirit is clear
He pleads on our behalf always
For those who are called by name

[Chorus]
With groanings too deep for words
He prays to the Father above
The Spirit intercedes for us
According to God’s holy will

[Bridge]
We wait with patience for what we see not
Hope that is unseen sustains us
The firstfruits of the Spirit
Lead us to glory and light

[Chorus]
With groanings too deep for words
He prays to the Father above
The Spirit intercedes for us
According to God’s holy will

[Outro]
Groanings too deep for words
He intercedes for the saints
